Done while the office sleeps. Small companies get the same attacks as big ones, without a security team to stop them. Alfred covers the six places almost every break in starts, every night, on its own. It fixes what it can without asking and writes one short note in the morning. Most days the note says everything is fine. Some days it asks you for one thing. Morning note Tue 07:45 Passkeys 12 of 14 people Email 1 invoice held Devices 22 checked Secrets 3 moved to the vault Updates 11 installed Backups Restore passed One thing for you: confirm the held invoice from a new supplier.
